h1: Make Instagram Ads from One Product Photo
lead: Turn one product photo into an Instagram ad. Choose a Reel-style clip or a square still, then download the file when it is ready.
card: Reel-style clips and square product images from one photo.

faq.q: Can I make an Instagram ad from one product photo?
faq.a: Yes. Upload one clear photo, describe your product moment and choose a Reel-style clip or square still. The credit cost appears before you start.

faq.q: Which Instagram placements can I make ads for?
faq.a: Make a 9:16 clip for Reels or Stories, or a square still to crop for the Feed and carousel. Choose the file the placement asks for.

faq.q: Do I need to book an Instagram creator or studio?
faq.a: No. Start from your own product photo, so there is no creator booking, studio day or footage queue.

faq.q: How do I build an Instagram carousel?
faq.a: Run one square job for each slide, such as a front view, in-hand view or close detail, then assemble the stills in Instagram.

faq.q: Does the download include captions or music?
faq.a: No. Add your caption, stickers and sound in Instagram, Canva or Ads Manager after download.

faq.q: What photo should I upload for Instagram ads?
faq.a: Use a sharp photo that shows the whole product and leaves a little space around it for controls and crops.

faq.q: Can I make different Instagram versions?
faq.a: Yes. Run another job from the same photo with a different scene or opening without arranging another shoot.

faq.q: Can I use the file in paid Instagram campaigns?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads have no AIVideosUGC watermark. Follow Meta's current ad-review rules when you publish.
